name: Barney
biography: Barney, born in Jan 1999, is a huge full grown male Kodiak/Grizzly, standing over 8 feet and weighing in at 1300 pounds. Some of his credits include the feature films "Grizzly Falls", "Anchorman", "Mr. Nobody","Pathfinder", and "Knucklehead".
movies: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
